title: SQL for Analysts
tagline: Answer real business questions with SQL you can defend line by line.
description: Most SQL courses teach syntax. This one teaches you to answer questions. You join the data team at Cartwheel, an online store selling in eight countries, and work through a queue of requests from its CEO, marketing, operations and finance leads. Every query runs in your browser against a real SQLite database with two years of orders, customers, returns, support tickets and web sessions.

You start with filtering, NULL logic and dates, then learn to aggregate and join without double counting, which is where most analyst mistakes hide. From there you move to CTEs, window functions, funnels and cohort retention, and finish with the habits that make results trustworthy: data-quality checks, query plans, readable style and the differences you will hit in PostgreSQL.
audience: Analysts, career switchers and developers who know basic SELECT and want to answer business questions with SQL confidently.
prerequisites: Basic spreadsheet skills and a first look at SELECT and FROM; no programming experience needed.
learnItems: Filter, sort and bucket data with WHERE, CASE and NULL-safe logic
Aggregate at the right grain and join tables without double counting
Find what is missing with anti-joins and walk hierarchies with CTEs
Rank, compare and accumulate rows with window functions
Build funnels, monthly cohorts and retention tables from raw events
Check data quality, read query plans and write SQL others can review
